text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Rob Faulkner has raised his stock rating and earnings estimates for Spine-Tech Inc due to increased visibility after its launch of a new fusion cage product for spinal fusion medical procedures.
-- Faulkner raised the rating to strong buy from buy.
-- He raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.34/shr from $0.29, fully taxed. Sales went to $40 million from $35.5 million.
-- He raised his 1998 earnings estimate to $0.70/shr from $0.64 and sales to $58.7 million from $55 million.
-- In a statement, he said the company is training surgeons faster than planned.
